text:
ڈنڈا کونڈا گھسے،
ملک خدا دا وسے،
ڈنڈا کونڈا پاݨی،
ملک خدا دا آبادانی۔
romanized:
Ḍanḍā kūṇḍā ghasse,
Mulk Khudā dā vasse,
Ḍanḍā kūṇḍā pāṇī,
Mulk Khudā dā āvādānī.
literal_en:
Pestle and mortar grind,
God's world lives,
Pestle, mortar, water,
God's world flourishes.

source.book: Grammar and Dictionary of Western Panjabi, as spoken in the Shahpur District, with Proverbs, Sayings and Verses
